Body.Content:
Azure IoT Edge

Support for IoT Edge in IoT Central is now GA. Integration with Azure IoT Edge lets you remotely manage devices that run intelligence workloads locally, such as telemetry analysis.

Azure Sphere

Azure Sphere integration enables solution builders to connect highly-secure devices with a high-level application platform to their IoT Central application. 

Diagnostics UI

Operators can now view raw telemetry data from within an IoT Central application. This feature is further supported by Azure CLI integration.

Public safety application template

This new application template lets you build cross-industry applications that deliver real-time surveillance and security. The template uses video analytics and indoor mapping of private spaces.

Learn more
